label: Unsolved Mystery
titel: The Ship With No One Aboard

szenen.text: In 1872, a ship was found *drifting* with nobody on board.
It was the *Mary Celeste,* near the Azores.
Her cargo was *untouched.* Six months of food and water remained.
Ten people had sailed: the captain, his wife, *their daughter,* seven crew.

archiv.datei: File:Lap desk of Captain Benjamin Briggs from the Mary Celeste (PEM M6557) 01.jpg

szenen.text: The ship was towed to *Gibraltar.* Inspectors found no proof of foul play.
Most likely, they left in the lifeboat and *were lost.*
What really made them *abandon* a seaworthy ship? Your theory?
